column1: # PH-85 S85d (A mechanism) edits after the M0 commit. J1 (body-hash set
# unchanged) holds at the M0 commit; these are the only bodies S85d changed or
# added, listed here so `p85_m0` can tell "a later task edited it" from "the
# move itself rewrote it". Every moved function must still be byte-identical.
